comments.text: Open: task filters not yet implemented.

Blocked on team intent: the existing test 'examples index is simplified without browse filters' (test/agent_jido_web/live/jido_examples_live_test.exs) deliberately removed browse filters, and 7 index tests assert the simplified rendering. E08-T02..T06 ask for filters, which contradicts that decision. Needs product confirmation to re-introduce filters (and update those tests) before implementing. Left open.

Product decision 2026-07-24: deferred for this iteration. Keep the Examples hub simple and card-based. Do not add search or filter controls. Use clear cards, use-case entry points, and direct documentation links for discovery. Reconsider in a future iteration.

title: E08-T03 — Add task filters.
